zoe: quick flag 3: customer reported org quota increments when using an SA that we thought mapped to a project. looks like fallback to org-owner. anyone? 
ben: saw that in logs. claim.project is empty for those tokens, router falls back to owner_org -> default org. noisy for tenants. 
arjun: short-term: emit metric routing.assigned_target and routing.reason (project|owner_org|default_org) so we can count. low-overhead. 
zoe: agree. UI: key page should show 'effective target' and a button 'bind to project' that creates a mapping. avoids surprise. 
ben: longer-term: allow X-Effective-Project header signed by issuer to influence routing. canary that behavior first. must validate signature. 
arjun: canary plan: 5% of router traffic will prefer signed header; emit a delta metric for changed_assignments. ops-bot: scheduled canary job auth-routing-canary id=can-65000 rate=0.05 
ops-bot: job created auth-routing-canary (rate=0.05) 
zoe: add an alert if changed_assignments >0.1% or if any customer files a ticket referencing billing mismatch. 
ben: I'll open PR for telemetry and a tiny router flag. arjun will do canary patch. 
arjun: yep. will include signature validation by issuer pubkey and TTL check. 
zoe: thanks. if canary goes green we'll ship console change and docs. :thumbsup:
